source: GONG mrzqs zero-point-corrected QuickReduce synoptic maps
availability_rule: max(GONG DATE-OBS + 2 h, source HTTP Last-Modified) <= forecast origin
longitude_convention: CCMC DONKI CMEAnalysis view labels Direction LON/LAT in HEEQ; SunPy documents HEEQ as the Cartesian representation of heliographic Stonyhurst. Convert the launch-time Stonyhurst longitude to Carrington using SunPy L0; GONG PFSS/SCS grid is Carrington
scs_method: PFSS at 2.5 R_sun; use abs(Br) on its source surface as the positive inner SCS boundary; solve the pseudo-potential shell scaled from 1 to 2 (physical 2.5 to 5 R_sun); restore the PFSS polarity sign on the outer radial field. The sign boundary is radially mapped without SCS field-line tracing.
event_policy: latest eligible level-0/1 CMEAnalysis revision per event with submissionTime <= origin; prefer associatedCMEstartTime, fallback to time21_5 only when launch time is absent

feature_definitions.cme_present_72h: 1 iff the selected eligible launch is in [origin-72h, origin]
feature_definitions.cme_age_h: origin minus selected associatedCMEstartTime in hours
feature_definitions.source_hcs_signed_sep_deg: DONKI CME center latitude minus nearest SCS HCS latitude at the launch Carrington longitude
feature_definitions.earth_hcs_signed_sep_deg: Earth B0 latitude minus nearest SCS HCS latitude at origin L0
feature_definitions.cme_earth_same_sector: 1 iff source- and Earth-relative signed HCS separations have the same sign
feature_definitions.cme_cone_hcs_overlap: 1 iff the minimum spherical separation from the CME center to any HCS contour sample is <= DONKI halfAngle
feature_definitions.hcs_tilt_local_deg: atan of local d(latitude)/d(Carrington longitude) at the Earth meridian
feature_definitions.hcs_warp_rms_deg: RMS residual from a local linear HCS-latitude fit across +/-30 degrees of Earth meridian
feature_definitions.hcs_crossing_count_cone: number of discrete HCS contour samples inside the CME cone
feature_definitions.cme_hcs_interaction_score: cone proximity times speed/1000 times a same-sector factor (1.0 same, 0.5 opposite)
feature_definitions.cme_hcs_missing: 1 when CME event or usable prior HCS geometry is unavailable; otherwise 0

cache_key: sha256(compute_hcs.py, hcs_config.json, full GONG manifest, and each source-map SHA256)
